Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (contact: Jasmine Alzate, JALZATE@dallasisd.org) is issuing Bid JA-207652 for Student and Staff Computing Devices, including Chromebooks (100,000 units across three tiers), Windows laptops (5,000), tablets (50,000), staff laptops/desktops (30,000 total), and display monitors (10,000 total). Bids are due July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via iSupplier portal or sealed envelope submission to Dallas ISD Procurement Services. The contract term is three years initial with two successive one-year extensions, not to exceed five years total. Key requirements include Form 1295, W-9 Form, MWBE Forms, Certificate of Insurance/Bond within 10 days of award, and Standard Form-LLL if applicable; additionally, bidders must provide white glove delivery services (asset decaling, reporting, etching) and software enrollment services (Windows Autopilot and Google Management). Addendum 2 updated the due date from June 27, 2024, and Addendum 1 established that delivery begins September 2024 with coordination required with the Dallas ISD ED TECH department.
